answer_1.quote: We evaluate the models on MT-Bench ... and on a Summarization dataset ... The experiments are conducted on four preference datasets: UltraFeedback, HH‑RLHF, Summarization, and Chinese CVALUES.
answer_1.outputs: Model‑generated responses to prompts (e.g., answers, summaries, instructions).

answer_2.quote: We leverage the Negative Flip Rate (NFR) ... we employ well‑trained RMs to directly score the responses ... UltraRM‑13b for UltraFeedback and DeBERTa V3 Large for HH‑RLHF and Summarization.

answer_3.quote: We also use Llama3 70B as an evaluator ... to assess NFR and win rates.
